_comment: Source of truth for the Pi release this package has explicitly accepted as supported. The upstream-watch workflow compares npm's `latest` dist-tag of @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent against `accepted`; a human bumps `accepted` only after a compatibility review. Never edited by automation. See support/README.md.

pi.label: Pi
notes: 0.87.1 — the release the design research was done against (source HEAD 96724621 of earendil-works/pi). The Stage 0 recordings pin the version they were made with in each fixture's meta.recordedWith; if that differs from this value, the recordings win and this entry is updated in the same PR.

This package couples to three surfaces Pi does not promise to keep across 0.x minors: (1) the session JSONL format (header version 3, entry types and message roles; src/transcript/SessionFile.ts), (2) the extension event names and payload fields the bridge subscribes to (src/bridge/extension.ts), and (3) the CLI flags --session-id and -e (src/launch/prepareLaunch.ts). Unknown entry types and fields are ignored, so most drift degrades rather than breaks; a renamed extension event does NOT fail closed on its own, which is why every drift needs the compatibility pass, not just a green suite.
The package name moved from @mariozechner/pi-coding-agent (deprecated at 0.73.1) to @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent; the source moved from badlogic/pi-mono to earendil-works/pi.
